articles.title: Disney's live-action Moana crashes to shore with an underwhelming splash at the box office
articles.summary: This latest Moana brings Dwayne Johnson back as the demigod Maui and introduces Catherine Lagaʻaia as the adventuring Polynesian princess. articles.title: US Senators, Administration Agree To Advance Russia Sanctions Bill; Kyiv Hails Move

articles.title: US Expands Pressure Campaign With New Sanctions On Iran's Financial Networks
